description: Output bit frequency per arm at full 7-bit input range. Confirms Anna ITU outputs are dominated by '0' bits (negative trits, -1 → '0').

anna.interpretation: 85.7% of output bits are '0' (i.e., trit = -1). The remaining 0.5% '?' come from output trit = 0 (no positive or negative sum reached threshold).

implications: Anna's apparent 'sparse output' is actually 'negative-trit dominant output'.
ternary_clamp(sum) = -1 when sum < 0, +1 when sum > 0, 0 when sum = 0.
Anna's weights × wrap-around steady-state bias the output sums negative.
The 84% '0' bits explain most of D1c's bias-only predictions for sparse-gage tasks (parity_eq, AND, mult_low).
D1c's residual analysis correctly isolates the task-conditional structure beyond this bias.
